    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">PC端自动化测试实战教程-9-pywinauto操作应用程序窗口的级联菜单（详细教程）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3>1.简介</h3>
<p>其实前边关于这一知识点也有涉及和提到过，只是当时没有说，不信宏哥提一下，你想一想之前宏哥介绍的记事本输入内容，然后操作记事本的文件-&gt;另存为，这里的另存为就是文件的级联菜单。今天宏哥就给小伙伴或者童鞋们来讲解和分享一下这个知识点。</p>
<h3>2.什么是级联菜单？</h3>
<h4>2.1级联菜单的定义与特点‌</h4>
<p class="marklang-paragraph">‌级联菜单‌（Cascade Menu）是一种‌多层级嵌套的菜单结构‌，通过逐级展开的方式呈现选项<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">1<span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">3。其核心特点包括：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p class="marklang-paragraph">‌层级结构‌</p>
<ul>
<li>主菜单项触发后展开子菜单，子菜单可继续延伸更深层级（如&nbsp;<code>文件-&gt;另存为-&gt;PDF格式</code>）<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li>通过符号&nbsp;<code>-&gt;</code>&nbsp;表示层级路径（例如&nbsp;<code>帮助-&gt;关于记事本</code>）<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="marklang-paragraph">‌交互方式‌</p>
<ul>
<li>用户需逐级点击或悬停触发下一级菜单显示。</li>
<li>在自动化操作中，需按层级路径精准定位控件（如&nbsp;<code>menu_select("一级-&gt;二级-&gt;三级")</code>）<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="marklang-paragraph">‌控件类型‌</p>
<ul>
<li>常见控件类型为&nbsp;<code>MenuBar</code>（菜单栏）、<code>MenuItem</code>（菜单项）和&nbsp;<code>Menu</code>（子菜单）<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li>通过&nbsp;<code>child_window()</code>&nbsp;方法可逐层定位到具体控件（例如先定位“编辑”再找“时间/日期”）<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="marklang-paragraph">‌典型应用场景‌</p>
<ul>
<li>应用程序主菜单栏（如记事本的“文件”“编辑”“帮助”等）<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li>右键上下文菜单（如桌面右键菜单的“新建-&gt;文件夹”）<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h4>‌2.1与普通菜单的差异‌</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>‌特性‌</th><th>‌级联菜单‌</th><th>‌普通菜单‌</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>层级结构</td>
<td>多级嵌套</td>
<td>单层平铺</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>交互复杂度</td>
<td>需逐级展开</td>
<td>直接点击选项</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>典型控件类型</td>
<td><code>MenuBar</code>&nbsp;+&nbsp;<code>MenuItem</code></td>
<td><code>Button</code>&nbsp;或&nbsp;<code>ListBox</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3>3.操作方法</h3>
<p>pywinauto提供了操作级联菜单的方法，使用menu_select()方法就可以操作级联菜单控件。</p>
<h3>4.项目实战</h3>
<p>因为宏哥的系统是Windows11，所以这里为了减少不必要的麻烦主要还是通过Windows安装的Notepad++编辑器进行演示和实践。这里宏哥介绍两种常见的定位级联菜单控件的方法。</p>
<h4>4.1多级路径定位（<code>menu_select()</code>）</h4>
<p>1.这种用 -&gt;分隔多级菜单项，适用于静态菜单。Notepad++编辑器：文件(F)-&gt;新建(N)，然后新建一个标签页，如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202504/1232840-20250424115333160-1304941668.gif" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h5>4.1.1代码设计</h5>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202504/1232840-20250424115527563-181305055.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h5>4.1.2参考代码</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> -*- coding:utf-8 -*-</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1.先设置编码，utf-8可支持中英文，如上，一般放在第一行</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2.注释：包括记录创建时间，创建人，项目名称。</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
Created on 2025-04-25
@author: 北京-宏哥
北京宏哥（微信搜索：北京宏哥，关注宏哥，提前解锁更多测试干货！）
Project: PC端自动化测试实战教程-9-pywinauto操作应用程序窗口的级联菜单（详细教程）
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3.导入模块</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pywinauto <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Application
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time

app </span>= Application(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">uia</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>).start(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:/software/Notepad/Notepad++/notepad++.exe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
win </span>= app.window(title=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">新文件 1 - Notepad++</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> win.print_ctrl_ids()</span>
win.menu_select(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文件(F) -&gt; 新建(N)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h5>4.1.3运行代码</h5>
<p>1.运行代码，右键Run'Test'，就可以看到控制台输出，如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202504/1232840-20250424130529292-984942569.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>2.运行代码后电脑端的动作（启动Notepad++编辑器，然后新建了一个Notepad++编辑器标签页【新文件2】）。如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202504/1232840-20250424130444770-1455181346.gif" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4>4.2逐层点击控件（动态菜单处理）</h4>
<p class="marklang-paragraph">1.使用&nbsp;<code>child_window()</code>&nbsp;逐级定位。同样的操作不同的定位方法，Notepad++编辑器：文件(F)-&gt;新建(N)，然后新建一个标签页，如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202504/1232840-20250424115333160-1304941668.gif" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>2.按照前边宏哥讲解的方法，查看控件的结构树，宏哥这里为了让大家看清楚使用代码打印出来，然后找到<strong>文件(F)</strong>，这就是我们要定位的，如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202504/1232840-20250424131308551-1657045518.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h5>4.1.1代码设计</h5>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202504/1232840-20250424132346003-1110868215.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h5>4.1.2参考代码</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> -*- coding:utf-8 -*-</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1.先设置编码，utf-8可支持中英文，如上，一般放在第一行</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2.注释：包括记录创建时间，创建人，项目名称。</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
Created on 2025-04-25
@author: 北京-宏哥
北京宏哥（微信搜索：北京宏哥，关注宏哥，提前解锁更多测试干货！）
Project: PC端自动化测试实战教程-9-pywinauto操作应用程序窗口的级联菜单（详细教程）
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3.导入模块</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pywinauto <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Application
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time

app </span>= Application(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">uia</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>).start(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:/software/Notepad/Notepad++/notepad++.exe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
win </span>= app.window(title=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">新文件 1 - Notepad++</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> win.print_ctrl_ids()</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 点击一级菜单并选择子项</span>
win.child_window(title=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文件(F)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, control_type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MenuItem</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 操作动态加载的菜单</span>
win.menu_select(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文件(F) -&gt; 新建(N)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h5>4.1.3运行代码</h5>
<p>1.运行代码，右键Run'Test'，就可以看到控制台输出，如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202504/1232840-20250425085730298-718110310.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>2.运行代码后电脑端的动作（启动otepad++编辑器：文件(F)-&gt;新建(N)，然后新建一个标签页）。如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202504/1232840-20250425085857052-1411488607.gif" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3>&nbsp;5.小结</h3>
<h4>5.1注意事项‌</h4>
<ol>
<li>‌控件识别‌<br>使用&nbsp;<code>Inspect.exe</code>&nbsp;或&nbsp;<code>Accessibility Insights</code>&nbsp;工具确认菜单项的&nbsp;<code>title</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>control_type</code>&nbsp;属性<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li>‌延迟处理‌<br>部分菜单加载需要时间，可通过&nbsp;<code>time.sleep(0.5)</code>&nbsp;或&nbsp;<code>wait()</code>&nbsp;方法增加等待。</li>
<li>‌Backend选择‌<br>传统 Win32 应用使用&nbsp;<code>backend="win32"</code>，现代应用（如 WPF、UWP）使用&nbsp;<code>backend="uia"</code><span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>



</ol>
<p class="marklang-paragraph">通过上述方法，可灵活实现多层级联菜单的自动化操作。实际应用中需结合控件属性调试，确保路径准确<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="marklang-paragraph"><span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId "><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId ">&nbsp;好了，时间不早了今天就分享到这里，感谢你耐心地阅读！</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
